Planning a bathroom remodel without plumbing surprises

Moving a toilet or shower drain is the most expensive part of most remodels. Keeping fixtures roughly where they are now saves time and money.

Bring us in early, before the tiles are chosen, and we can tell you what is easy and what is not.
